# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin — Spend Limits

> 9 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under Spend Limits. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Spend Limits

- [Approve Spend Limit Increase Request](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/spend_limits/increase_requests/approve.md): New per-user spend limit as a non-negative integer decimal string (minor units).
- [Delete Spend Limit](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/spend_limits/delete.md): Delete a per-user spend limit override.
- [Deny Spend Limit Increase Request](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/spend_limits/increase_requests/deny.md): Deny a pending spend limit increase request.
- [Get Spend Limit](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/spend_limits/retrieve.md): Retrieve a spend limit by ID.
- [Get Spend Limit Increase Request](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/spend_limits/increase_requests/retrieve.md): Retrieve a spend limit increase request.
- [Increase Requests](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/spend_limits/increase_requests.md): New per-user spend limit as a non-negative integer decimal string (minor units).
- [List Effective Spend Limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/spend_limits/list_effective.md): Maximum number of members per page. A member's period rows never split across pages, so a page may carry more rows than this.
- [List Spend Limit Increase Requests](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/spend_limits/increase_requests/list.md): List spend limit increase requests, most recent first.
- [Set Spend Limit](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/spend_limits/create.md): Set a per-user spend limit override.
